name: nuspace-ui
description: The nuspace app: hosted web shell for the nuspace runtime. Bundled by vite; served by the nuspace core.
comment:dev-link: ui-core and ui-kit are DEV LINKS to the sibling nu checkout, not registry deps. The published 0.1.x is the pre-tree world (flat store, mount envelope) and nothing has been republished since nu.ui became a tree, so a caret range can only ever fetch the old one. `file:` and not a vite/tsc alias on purpose: npm makes a real symlink, `npm ls` says LINK, and the version field is a path, so nobody mistakes this for a registry resolution. Undo at release time: put the caret ranges back and `npm install` once the kit publishes a version with the tree bindings in it.
